comments.body: Found this sword using random Search looking for dropped items in Muscat. It is technically no longer Unobtainable.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: It's been released in Astro bottle drops at various points in UWO's history. You probably found one discarded by a player (their name would show). I own one myself, gifted to me by a friend in the past.
